During the early years of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]-backed '''insurgency''' in the [[Illoud system/Legends|Illoud system]] threatened the stability of the region. A New Republic force, commanded by [[Huoba Neva]], succeeded in eliminating the insurgency.<ref name="DES" />
